description: In front of you are an open cardboard box on the right, with an open notebook and some clothes piled near the middle-left. The left hand grips the near rim of the box to steady it while the right hand reaches rightward to drop a white paper cup into the box, then stretches left to lift a yellow book and place it inside, followed by picking up a small gray keychain-like item and setting it into the box; next the right hand gathers a black shirt and stuffs it into the box, then scoops up the light gray clothing pile and pushes it down on top while the left hand continues holding the box in place.
